candidates.rationale: The failures suggest that arbitrary placements frequently leave the crate immobile or the agent unable to reach a pushing side. This algorithm constructs a push route using locally certified turns, then places the agent within walking reach of its first support square. Sample-derived ordering varies positions, orientations, route lengths, turns, and approach distances. It preserves the exact obstacles and minimum endpoint distance, uses no randomness or joint-state search, and never rejects a completed scene. Restrictive boards receive a validity-preserving geometric fallback. No candidate code was executed; performance improvement is unmeasured.
